m.text: An eldritch lily mixed into 250 gp worth of specially-prepared purified fluids, which the spell consumes

entries: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is immune to necrotic damage and cannot gain {@adventure contamination levels|DoDk|12}. The affected creature may rest normally within the Haze.
This spell ends immediately if the creature casts a contaminated spell.
name: Contamination Immunity
